name: ugc-chart
description: Many more data points to help you find the right Trybe creators for your brand.

interface.longDescription:
Many more data points to help you find the right Trybe creators for your brand.

On top of Trybe's own data, UGC Chart adds data points we build by tracking every creator, every day:
- Sales per approved video: roughly how much each approved video sells
- Week over week: is their sales range going up or down, and are they posting more or fewer videos?
- Day by day: their 30-day sales range on each day this week
- Samples delivered: how many free samples were due a video this week, and how many got one
- Newest video: when they last added a featured video to their Trybe profile
- Rank in category: like "#3 in Trybe's top 100 Beauty & Personal Care sellers"
- Few videos, big sales: a badge for creators who sell a lot from only a few videos
- Seen in paid ads: brands we track running their Trybe videos as Facebook and Instagram ads
- Weekly chart: the top 50 Trybe creators by sales, and who moved the most
- Similar creators: find more creators like one you already like

Just ask in plain words:
- "Find 5 skin care creators who are growing this week, with 90% approval or more"
- "Which beauty creators get big sales from only a few videos?"
- "Did this creator deliver on their free samples this week?"
- "Compare these 3 creators side by side"

We add new data points as our history grows.

Sales are 30-day ranges, like $50K+, never exact numbers. UGC Chart only reads data. It never changes or sends anything. Sign in with a work email. 200 lookups a day.

positive.description: Find creators with big sales from few videos
positive.prompt: Which beauty creators get big sales from only a few videos?
positive.expected_behavior: Return beauty creators with the few videos, big sales badge, with their 30-day sales range, videos in 30 days and approval rate.

positive.prompt: Compare Melissa S., Elijah L. and Xavier R. side by side
positive.expected_behavior: Show sales range, videos in 30 days, approval rate, sample delivery and badges for all three side by side.

positive.prompt: Show me creators like Wear T.
positive.expected_behavior: Return creators in the same top category and sales range, closest in video count.

positive.prompt: Who is on this week's top 50?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the weekly Top 50 Trybe creators by sales with rank and sales range.

positive.prompt: Tell me about Melissa S. on UGC Chart
positive.expected_behavior: Return her sales range, rank in category, approval rate, sample delivery, badges and handles.
